notes.title: Once Ever After is released!
notes.notes:
Hello! If you enjoyed playing Ouroboros, I hope that you might also be interested in Once Ever after, my newest JRPG:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/951860/Once_Ever_After/

Once Ever After may not be as twisty as Ouroboros, but it also has meta-story elements and subverts a few genres. It's a longer and more polished game that I hope you might enjoy, if you liked the writing and gameplay elements in Ouroboros. Please consider taking a look. ^-^

notes.title: Sierra's Developer Page
notes.notes:
Steam has just launched an open beta for creator homepages, which I think is definitely a good thing. Before, it was necessary to use game page updates to talk about new games, which never felt quite right to me. Now, if you are interested in following me as a creator, there's a centralized location!

First, you can anonymously follow my dev page to be informed of new releases, sales, and so on:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/sierralee/

That page is built on top of a public group, which you can join here:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/sierralee

Updates to this game or information about direct sequels or spinoffs will still be posted here.

If you like what you've seen of my work, please do look into these new features! I've started off simple and I don't intend to spam anyone on these groups, but I think they will prove useful later for grouping my games by genre and series as well as communicating with everyone.

That's all for now. Thank you for your interest in my games!

notes.title: Coming Eventually!
notes.notes:
Ouroboros was my first completed commercial game. I created it under game jam styled conditions as a break from other projects, trying to do something unique with limited resources and in a short time period. Since the concept was well-received, I later refined and expanded it, including getting some custom art.

Since I started putting games on Steam, a common request has been to make Ouroboros available here as well. Well, I'm finally getting to that... eventually. I want to release it when I won't lose momentum from my new projects, plus I need to get through the Steam review and add some features like achievements. All that will happen, just not right away.

So if you want to be informed about the game's release, this is the page to follow! Ouroboros will eventually be available here at a reduced price, with achievements and a few refinements. Please look forward to it. ^-^
